note: Every page the dashboard still draws in English, with the part that takes it and the printed pages the finder counts English on. On a Spanish pass the check runs on every page; a page listed here is expected to be English and does not fail the run, and a page that is not listed has to be Spanish through and through. A page listed here that starts passing DOES fail the run, so a part is never finished without its entries coming off. A part takes its pages off as it translates them, prints included, and house-style fails the run when the prints a page names are not the ones the finder counts English on it.
